entities.summary: Benigno Filomeno de Rojas Ramos was a Dominican lawyer, economist, and politician. He served as the Head of State of the Dominican Republic from January 24, 1865, until March 24 of that year. Before that, he served as the vice president of that country under President Pedro Santana's administration from 1858 to 1861.
